payload.description: Exactly-once retry claim tracking. Identity ensures at most one dispatch per (selected_root_ref + original_idempotency_key) pair. State machine: PENDING → DISPATCHED|RECONCILING|TERMINAL. CAS-owned mutations; no EEAF writes.

properties.description: Reference to the selected-root authority record (identity half #1)
Address of the original operation receipt that triggered discovery
Lifecycle state: PENDING (ready to dispatch), DISPATCHED (dispatch issued), RECONCILING (awaiting acceptance), TERMINAL (completed)
Address of the receipt from the successful dispatch
Address of prior retry attempt if this is a re-attempt
Timestamp of the most recent state transition

payload.description: Exactly-once retry of a failed operation. Identity=(selected_root_ref, original_idempotency_key). On duplicate identity, returns existing claim without re-dispatch.

original_idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key from the original failed operation

failed_operation_receipt_ref.description: Address of the failed operation receipt

original_operation_ref.description: Name/ref of the operation that originally failed

signed_dispatch_admission_ref.description: Address of the signed approval authorizing this retry

state.description: Current state of the retry claim

cardinality.description: Count of dispatch receipts (must be exactly 1)

invariants: Identity (selected_root_ref + original_idempotency_key) is unique; duplicate inputs return existing claim without re-dispatch
State machine is atomic: PENDING→DISPATCHED is irreversible
Exactly one dispatch receipt per identity; cardinality enforcement at readback
Signed admission is required; unsigned calls are rejected
CAS ownership: only this operation writes retry-claim state; no EEAF mutation

payload.description: Duplicate identity resolves to the same retry-claim; no second dispatch receipt is created
payload.assertion: cardinality == 1; both calls return the same retry_claim_address

payload.description: State transition PENDING→DISPATCHED is atomic; concurrent attempts see either old state or new state, never partial
payload.action: Attempt concurrent dispatch from two sources
payload.assertion: One succeeds (DISPATCHED, dispatch_receipt_ref set); other sees DISPATCHED state and returns same receipt

payload.description: State=RECONCILING is recoverable; re-dispatch returns original dispatch receipt
payload.action: Call retry-original-intent again with same identity
payload.assertion: Returns state=RECONCILING, dispatch_receipt_ref is the original dispatch receipt

payload.description: Same idempotency_key with different selected_root creates separate retry-claims
payload.assertion: Two separate retry_claim_address values; no deduplication across roots
Dispatch is rejected; no retry-claim is created

payload.verifies: Authority deletion orphans claims; readback fails closed
payload.scenario: TRUE-RETRACT the selected-root authority record (omit payload — never payload:null, L137), then exact-read an existing retry-claim for that root
payload.expected: The claim record itself remains readable (found:true) but the authority linkage resolution fails — any new retry-original-intent dispatch for that root is REJECTED (no authority = no dispatch, fail-closed); cardinality of dispatch receipts remains frozen at its pre-deletion value
